title: Output equation for an accepting witness
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ input bits, and let $w$ be an input word that the circuit accepts. The canonical quadratic witness formed from $w$ and the values of all gates satisfies the circuit’s quadratic output equation.
hypotheses_covered: The circuit accepts the input word
